info.name: MW Realty — Agent App API
info.description: The CRM endpoints the MW Realty agent app calls, by app tab: Entry, Home, Leads, Add listing, Listings, More.

item.name: Entry
item.description: Sign-in (with the email code / two-factor steps when the account needs them), then onboarding and verification: the agent completes the profile, uploads the documents and submits it for approval. `GET /api/crm/auth/me` says what is still missing. Until the account is approved, the Leads and Listings endpoints answer `403`.

request.description:
Either signs in straight away (`token` in the response), or asks for the next step:
`challenge: "email"` → `POST /api/crm/auth/login/verify-email`,
`challenge: "totp"` → `POST /api/crm/auth/login/two-factor`, passing the `challenge_token`.

The 6-digit code emailed by the sign-in step. Answers like Sign in: a `token`, or
`challenge: "totp"` for the authenticator-app step. `restart: true` = start over with the password.
The authenticator-app code, or one of the account's recovery codes. Returns the `token`.

response.body: {"message": "That code is not valid. Check your authenticator app and try again."}

request.description:
Who is signed in and what they can open — the app's start-up call. `approved: false`
means KYC is still pending: only profile screens work until Super Admin approves.
Revokes the token used for this request (other devices stay signed in).

A new secret to add to the authenticator app — as a QR code (`qr_svg`), an `otpauth://`
link (`uri`, opens the app directly on the same phone) or typed in (`secret`). Moving 2FA
that is already on to a new phone needs the account `password`; the old app keeps working
until the new one is confirmed.

The first code the authenticator app shows. Switches 2FA on and returns the recovery
codes — show them once and ask the user to keep them safe. A company can pass
`enforce: true` to make 2FA mandatory for every agent right away.

response.body: {"message": "That code is not valid. Make sure you scanned the latest QR code and that your phone's time is correct."}

request.description: After sign-up, when 2FA isn't required by the agency — it can be turned on later.

item.name: Home
item.description:
New leads, leads awaiting a first response, listings needing action — from the dashboard. **Today's follow-ups** have no endpoint yet (see the introduction).

**Also uses (connected):**

* `GET /api/crm/leads` — see **Leads**
* `GET /api/crm/properties` — see **Listings**
* `GET /api/crm/notifications` — see **More**

request.description:
KPIs with 30-day trends, 12-week activity, deal pipeline by stage, lead sources, busiest
weekday, latest enquiries, most-enquired listings, inventory breakdown, plan usage (Super
Admin: top partners), alerts and shortcuts.

item.name: Leads
item.description: The inbox (enquiries and viewings from the website, the app, Facebook and Property Finder) and one lead: contact details, stage, tags, notes and — for agency managers — assigning it to an agent.

query.description: Name, email or phone (also every other email / phone it enquired with).
Agency only — leads assigned to this agent (`unassigned` = none).
Super Admin only — one account's leads.
A column key (see Leads screen set-up).

request.description: One page of the listing plus the stat-card counts (`quick_counts`, which ignore `q`).

What the Leads screen needs besides the rows: the table fields (`columns.shown` = the
viewer's saved order), agency extras (its agents, unassigned count, assignment mode) and a
lead import still running. Owner / stage / source / tag filter options page through
`/leads/owner-options` and `/leads/options/{type}`.

Your own items plus the shared ones, searched and paged on the server (20 per page —
load the `next_page` on scroll).

Everything on the lead screen: the lead, its emails / phones, enquiry details, activity
timeline, every enquiry it made (`source_history`), notes, purchases, assignment, the
stage / source / tag options it can be edited with, and the previous / next lead in your
list. Website activity loads separately (`GET /leads/{id}/insights/summary`).

Saves only the fields sent (one card at a time on the lead screen). `owner_id` (transfer
to another account) is Super Admin only.

Agency leads only — the owning agency (or Super Admin). `agent_id: null` moves the lead
back to agency level. Options come from the lead's `assignment.agent_options`.
Adds an entry to the lead's activity timeline, signed with your name.

item.name: Listings
item.description:
My listings by state (active, inactive, permit review), quick sold / rented, edit, photos and the sold / rented proof documents.

**Also uses (connected):**

* `POST /api/crm/properties/permit/validate` — see **Add listing**
* `GET /api/crm/properties/nearby-places` — see **Add listing**
* `GET /api/crm/properties/agent-options` — see **Add listing**
* `POST /api/crm/properties/{id}/feature` — see **Featured & ads**

query.description: Title, ref no, RERA, address, community or city (and agent / agency for Super Admin).
Agent id, or "none" = agency listings with no agent.

item.name: Featured & ads
item.description:
Promoting listings: **Featured** (Premium) listings and **advertisements** in the website / app ad sliders.Featured and ads are paid from the plan's allowance (`pay_with=plan`) or with credits (`pay_with=credits`). Opened from a listing ("Make premium") or from the More tab.

**Also uses (connected):**

* `GET /api/crm/properties` — see **Listings**

request.description:
With `pay_with=credits` (agents / companies) it's bought with credits for `days` (7, 15 or 30)
instead of using the plan's quota; no end date is sent.
A live feature keeps its start date (send null).
Live first (ending soonest), then scheduled — 20 per page, with the counts and the plan quota.

The same start / end dates for every ticked listing, all-or-nothing (FeaturedListingService::featureMany).
With `pay_with=credits` each is bought with credits for `days` (7, 15 or 30) instead.

item.name: Listings that can be made premium

request.description:
The "Add Premium" picker, searched and paged on the server (20 at a time). Owners only see
active listings that aren't premium or scheduled already.

The account's ads, newest booking first (20 per page), with impressions / clicks per ad, the
last 30 days' totals and the plan allowance. `quota.included` false = the plan has no
advertising (show the upgrade card).

Everything the "Book an ad" form needs: the pages ads can run on (with their credit prices and
how many run at once), the lengths the plan allows, the allowance and credit balance, the
active languages for the banner text, and the earliest start.

For each hour of a day (Dubai time) on a page: how many client ads are booked and how many
slots are still free. `past` hours can't be booked any more.

item.name: Listings an ad can link to

request.description:
The account's active listings, searched and paged on the server (20 at a time) — RemoteSelect's
`{data: [{id, name}], next_page}`.

formdata.description: Only you see it.
A page from the booking options.
Y-m-d H:i, Dubai time, on the hour.
One of the plan's lengths.
plan | credits.
property | profile | url.
With link_type=property.

request.description:
Multipart form. The ad waits for MW Realty's review and runs, once approved, from `start` for
`hours`. `pay_with=plan` uses the monthly allowance; `credits` spends credits (refunded if it's
rejected or cancelled before it runs).

The ad with its booking, review state and full report: totals, an hourly series over its run,
totals per day and its busiest hours.

Banner, text and link only, before the ad starts (send as multipart POST with `_method=PUT`).
The page, time and payment stay; it goes back to MW Realty's review.

Not started yet (or still in review): cancelled, with its credits / allowance given back.
Live: stops now — the time already used isn't refunded.

The wallet (balance, next expiry, top-up pricing) and its transactions, newest first, 20 per page.
Super Admin sees every account's.
Credit costs for these listings (the "pay with credits" option when making them premium), plus the balance.

item.name: More
item.description:
Team view for agency managers, notifications, profile and support.

**Also uses (connected):**

* `GET /api/crm/profile` — see **Entry**
* `POST /api/crm/profile` — see **Entry**
* `POST /api/crm/profile/avatar` — see **Entry**
* `POST /api/crm/auth/logout` — see **Entry**

request.description:
Newest first, 20 per page. `route` = the CRM screen it opens (name + params), when it has
one; otherwise open `url`.

response.body: {"data": [{"id": "9a1…", "title": "New lead", "message": "Sara Ahmed enquired about…", "icon": "fa-user-plus", "tone": "teal", "url": "https://…/portal/crm/leads/101", "route": {"name": "leads.show", "params": {"id": 101}}, "read": false, "created_at": "2026-10-09T10:00:00+00:00"}], "unread_count": 3, "next_page": null}

request.description: Emails a 4-digit code to the NEW address; nothing changes until it is verified.

The code swaps the email in and signs the account out everywhere (this browser's session, and
every app token) — they were all authenticated under the old identity.

Super Admin: every agent, 15 per page (`is_admin` true). Agency: the memberships of one tab,
15 per page, with tab counts, round-robin state, lead assignment settings and agent slots.
Profile, membership history with this agency, their agency listings (10 per page) and lead count.
Issue types, priorities and MW Realty's contact details (the "Get in touch" card).
